lines: d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Rebecca Wells is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d40: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d40: 🕯️ Rebecca is dead — and the dead hold no treaties. Every link Haven has shakes.

d40: Emberhold watches to see if Haven holds without its dead. The bond is young — they're still deciding what Haven is, and grief delays the verdict. They'll test the link — count on it, unless Haven answers first: send grain (1,500 kcal), send a speaker (2 days), or let the silence answer. (Trust -8.)
d40: 🕯️ Rebecca Wells is dead — the expedition. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d40: What Rebecca kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d40: "Rebecca's gone." Abigail looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Rebecca." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d40: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. Emmett blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Food Preservation (Level 1). Salt, smoke, dry. The big three. Salt draws water out; bacteria can't live without it.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: Camp Cooking (Level 1). Cooking uses half the water, +10% kcal. Once per day: add a Secret Ingredient (a random inventory item) — 50% delicious (+morale), 50% educational.
d40: 📖 LEARNED: The Forager’s Eye (Level 1). You walk slower and see more. Food was always there; now you notice it.
d40: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d40: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Rebecca Wells, 40 days. The mantle passes to Emmett Jin.
d40: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. Emmett Jin, 52 — a Vintner. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper.
d40: The village's quarrel was with Rebecca — and Rebecca is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d40: At the grave, Abigail, Daniela, Salman and 5 more speak for Emmett — "Rebecca trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d40: The fire knew Emmett before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.

lastSay: d111: 📻 The System whispers it, for once not delighted: the Finale. Every season needs its climax. This one is yours.
d111: — DAY 111 DAWN — The world wakes. Animals are active.
d111: The fire burns low. One new line in the journal: Papaya — named and noted.
d111: Whatever was at the door has moved on — or found easier meat. The call goes quiet.
d111: Dawn. You wake rested. (+30 health, energy restored. By the fire. Good enough.)
